P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Olaf''' gains {{pp|0 to 100 by 5|0 to 70|formula= 1% per 0.7% '''missing''' health. ''This is capped at 70% '''missing''' health.''|label1='''missing''' health|label=Percent of level-scaling value|key=%|key1=%|color=hp}} of {{sti|{{as|{{pp|50+(50/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|{{as|{{pp|8+(17/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20|key=%}} life steal}}}}.

Q.name: Undertow
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Olaf''' throws an axe to the target location that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies it passes through and {{tip|slows}} them for {{pp|type=distance traveled|1 to 3 for 9|400 to 1000|formula=1+(0.25 per 75 units traveled)}} seconds. Enemy {{tip|champions}} hit are also inflicted with {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|20% armor reduction}}}} for 4 seconds.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Monster Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|20 to 120}}|Total Monster Damage|{{ap|70+20 to 270+120}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description3: The axe remains in place for a duration equal to ''Undertow's'' cooldown, granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. '''Olaf''' can pick up the axe to reduce ''Undertow's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} to {{pp|2.5 to 0 for 6|0 to 2.5|type=seconds elapsed since axe landed|formula=2.5 (affected by ability haste) - seconds}}.
Q.description4: ''{{tt|Nearby monsters|100 range estimated}} are granted {{tip|ghosting}} for 5 seconds upon Undertow's cast.''

W.name: Tough It Out
W.description2: He also grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds for an amount that is capped at {{as|70% '''missing''' health}}.
W.description3: ''Tough It Out {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Olaf's''' basic attack timer.''

E.name: Reckless Swing
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Olaf''' strikes thunder onto the target enemy, dealing {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}}.
E.description2: If ''Reckless Swing'' kills the target, '''Olaf''' {{tip|heals}} himself equal to the {{as|{{sti|health|health cost}}}}.
E.description3: Basic attacks reduce ''Reckless Swing's'' {{sti|cooldown}} by 1 second, increased to 2 against monsters.

R.name: Ragnarok
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Olaf''' becomes enraged for 3 seconds, {{tip|cleanse|cleansing}} himself of all {{tip|crowd control}} and becoming {{tip|Cc-immune|immune to them}}, as well as gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and 10% increased [[size]]. For the first second of ''Ragnarok'', he also gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champions}} within 2000 units.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Attack Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 25% AD)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20|45|70}}%}}
R.description3: ''Ragnarok's'' duration is increased by and up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds for each basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} or cast of ''{{ai|Reckless Swing|Olaf}}'' against an enemy {{tip|champion}}.
